author: Scott Manley
description:
I've had a lot of questions about this, Ukraine launched  cruise missiles which managed to hit the Progress factory in Samara which, among other things, builds the Soyuz rocket.
While I don't know the full extent of the damage, I wanted to clarify what we do know and whether this might affect flights to the Space Station

title: Soyuz Rocket Factory Attacked By 'Flamingos'
